verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a support-site listing for 'Desktop Themes' under Personalization. That shows Windows has its own theme personalization, but nothing describes a GUI color picker, a background picker, or creating and saving a custom theme. missing for 10: documented GUI accent/color picker, documented background/wallpaper picker, documented workflow to create and save a custom system theme, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can create a custom system theme using a GUI color and background picker
